end.summary:
Jiya practised sorting numbers as odd or even by making pairs; they showed this method with 7, 13, and 47.
They first said 5 would remain from 47, then corrected this to 1 player after making pairs.
Jiya practised using the ones digit to decide odd or even; this still needs checking in new examples.
They identified 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 as even, and said 34 is even because no laddoo is left alone.
end.parentNote: Asha practised odd and even numbers with Jiya by making pairs and checking whether one item was left over. Jiya used the pairing method for 7, 13, and 47; they first said 5 would remain from 47, then corrected it to 1 after pairing 46. The ones-digit method was practised but needs more checking, so at home you can ask Jiya to sort a few numbers by looking at the last digit and explain why.
